statusNote: EVMS is no longer an independent, degree-granting institution with its own president. On July 1, 2024 it was integrated into Old Dominion University to form Macon & Joan Brock Virginia Health Sciences at Old Dominion University. The former EVMS president/provost/dean role has been folded into ODU: the successor health-sciences entity is led by Alfred Z. Abuhamad, MD, as Executive Vice President for Health Sciences at ODU (he also holds the title Dean of EVMS). A separate EVMS medical-school dean role was filled by Judette Louis, MD, MPH, effective September 2, 2025. Overall university president is ODU's Brian O. Hemphill. Note: a president served between Edward Brickell (to ~2000) and Harry Lester (from 2005) and reportedly 'left unexpectedly,' but that person's name could not be verified from official/non-Wikipedia sources, so that seat is left unrecorded rather than guessed.
